import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build per-device watermark (applied_event_ts) lookup from the
    # current snapshot.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    wm_map = target.set_index("device_id")["applied_event_ts"]

    cdc = cdc.merge(
        wm_map.rename("watermark"),
        on="device_id",
        how="left",
    )

    # A device with no row in target_snapshot has no watermark (NaN) ->
    # every event for it survives. Otherwise an event survives only if
    # its event_ts is STRICTLY greater than the device's watermark
    # (replays / late events with event_ts <= watermark are discarded).
    cdc["survives"] = cdc["watermark"].isna() | (cdc["event_ts"] > cdc["watermark"])

    surviving = cdc.loc[cdc["survives"], ["device_id", "event_seq", "event_ts", "reading"]].copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Among surviving events per device, pick the winner: latest by
    # (event_ts, event_seq), deterministic tie-break on event_seq.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    surviving = surviving.sort_values(
        by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
        kind="mergesort",  # stable sort for determinism
    )
    winners = surviving.drop_duplicates(subset="device_id", keep="first")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge winners back into the snapshot:
    #   - devices with a winning event -> update reading & applied_event_ts
    #   - devices without a winning event -> carry forward unchanged
    #   - brand-new devices (not previously in target) -> apply winner
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    merged = target.merge(
        winners[["device_id", "reading", "event_ts"]],
        on="device_id",
        how="outer",
        suffixes=("_old", "_new"),
    )

    merged["reading"] = merged["reading_new"].combine_first(merged["reading_old"])
    merged["applied_event_ts"] = merged["event_ts"].combine_first(merged["applied_event_ts"])

    result = merged[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]].sort_values(
        by="device_id", kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"new_snapshot": result}
